enrichment.headline: Adds $21,000 and six months for Anthonio's inspections at Markham Elementary playmatting project
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $21,000 to the special inspection agreement with Anthonio, Inc., raising it from $36,100 to $57,100. It also extends the end date from December 31, 2021 to June 30, 2022 (181 more days), because some manufacturers could not deliver product on the original schedule. The project is the Markham Elementary School playmatting and accessibility project, paid from Measure J.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Special Inspection Services for Construction – Anthonio, Inc. – Markham Elementary School Playmatting Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Extends Ninyo & Moore's Fremont High construction consulting agreement to December 31, 2021
enrichment.summary: This third amendment extends the Ninyo & Moore consulting agreement for the Fremont High School new construction project from August 17, 2021 to December 31, 2021. It adds no money. The new end date is before this vote, so the extension covers a period that had already passed.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 3, Independent Consultant Agreement for Professional Services – Ninyo & Moore – Fremont High School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Awards G & G Builders $179,890 for playmatting and asphalt repair at Hintil Kuu Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: G & G Builders will remove two play structures, repair asphalt with slurry seal, and install a new play structure and playmatting at the Hintil Kuu Child Development Center. The price includes a $15,000 general contingency allowance. Work is scheduled from March 10, 2022 to June 8, 2022 and is paid from Measure J.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – G & G Builders, Inc. – Hintil Kuu Child Development Center Playmatting Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Ninyo & Moore up to $175,645.80 for soil vapor and air testing at the Fremont High site through 2024
enrichment.summary: Ninyo & Moore will keep sampling and reporting on soil vapor points, indoor air and outdoor air every quarter at the Fremont High School new construction site, at the request of the state's Department of Toxic Substances Control (DTSC). The limit includes up to $15,967.80 for any additional services. Work began January 3, 2022, before this vote, and runs through December 31, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
